thread:
Maya: FYI Aurora Data reported a sudden bill jump on INV-2026-1142. Looks like an overnight ETL re-run duplicated three daily ingestion jobs on 2026-04-12. Estimated overcharge: $6,750. Asking for manual refund + a concession credit for next month. @Sam @Lena

Sam: Oof. Can we confirm duplication vs expected batch retry behavior? Is this client-side or our ingestion pipeline?

Lena: Preliminary check shows three identical job_ids recorded between 02:01-02:12 UTC. They look like server-side retries. I'll run logs and usage diff. @BillingBot invoice_lookup INV-2026-1142; usage_diff auroradata 2026-04-10 2026-04-14

BillingBot: Invoice INV-2026-1142 located. Billed amount: $27,300. Usage diff for auroradata: duplicate sequences detected on 2026-04-12: ingest-042-01, ingest-042-02, ingest-042-03 each 45,000 tokens. Flag confidence: 0.88. Possible duplicated tokens: 90,000. Estimated overcharge: $6,750.

Maya: Suggest we issue manual credit for $6,750 for the duplicated usage and offer a one-time account concession of $4,200 (one month reserved capacity credit) to smooth relationship => total concession $10,950. Need GL code and Accounting sign-off.

Mark (Accounting): Thx. Provide GL code and exact memo. Also confirm internal approval list. We need documented approvers for audit.

Maya: GL: 7010-ADJ. Memo: "Aurora Data - duplicate ingestion run 2026-04-12 - INV-2026-1142". Approvers: Sam (Sales lead), Lena (Billing), Fiona (CS).

Sam: Approved. We want to keep the customer. Approved for refund + concession.

Lena: Approved. I'll schedule manual adjustment in the billing console and set adjustment_type=manual_credit.

Fiona (CS): Approved from CS. I'll notify Aurora once posted and include a short apology note.

Maya: @BillingBot create_adjustment INV-2026-1142 amount 10950 code 7010-ADJ note "duplicate ingestion refund + concession" tag: auroradata

BillingBot: Adjustment created: ADJ-2149992222-01 status: pending_accounting_review.

Mark (Accounting): I reviewed ADJ-2149992222-01 and approve posting to ledger. Please attach signed approval memo to Jira FIN-4610 before EOD.

Maya: Memo uploaded and linked to FIN-4610. @Fiona please send: "We're sorry for the spike. We've issued a combined credit of $10,950 (ADJ-2149992222-01): $6,750 duplicate-usage refund and a $4,200 one-time reserved credit. This will appear on your next invoice."

Fiona (CS): Sent. Customer replied: "Appreciate the quick response. Please confirm when it's on our account."

Lena: Ran the manual credit. Queue shows ADJ-2149992222-01 -> posted to pending_ledger. Also filing a follow-up ticket with Eng to prevent overnight re-run loops.

Maya: Good. Also let's run a scan for similar overnight triple-runs in April. @BillingBot duplicate_scan date_range 2026-04-01 2026-04-30 threshold 0.85 -> report FIN-4611

BillingBot: duplicate_scan complete. Report FIN-4611 generated: 2 additional hits (customers: NimbusCloud, BlueLens). Summary attached to FIN-4611.

Mark (Accounting): Ledger posting scheduled. I'll post ADJ-2149992222-01 today and update FIN-4610 with entry id and posting timestamp.

Lena: Ledger shows ADJ-2149992222-01 posted at 2026-05-03 09:31 UTC. Marking adjustment complete.

Maya: Noted. Closing when customer confirms.

Fiona (CS): Customer confirmed receipt and closing their support ticket. Thanks team.

Maya: Thread resolved. Follow-up: ENG to prioritize fix for retry loop; Finance to review April duplicate_scan hits next week.
